{"type": "obligation", "text": "students are expected to use AI transparently and responsibly.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "students", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AI may support differentiation, feedback, and access, but must not replace human relationships, professional judgment, or essential skill development.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AI systems must be monitored for bias and disparate impact.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Access to AIsupported learning must not widen opportunity gaps.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AI integration must comply with FERPA, COPPA, PPRA, IDEA, ADA, Section 504, COMAR, and applicable Maryland law.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Districts must enforce data minimization, contractual safeguards, and cybersecurity protections.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Districts", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Schools must clearly define appropriate AI use, require transparency when AI is permitted, and redesign assessments to emphasize reasoning, process, and authentic demonstration of learning rather than reliance on detection tools.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Schools", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Rolespecific professional learning must equip teachers, leaders, and staff to evaluate AI outputs critically and use tools responsibly.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Students must develop the knowledge and skills to understand how AI systems function, evaluate bias and limitations, protect privacy, and use AI ethically across disciplines and grade levels.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Students", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "High-stakes operational systems, including predictive analytics and automated decision-support tools, require documented human review, equity monitoring, and transparent communication.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Districts must apply structured evaluation criteria, contractual protections, and ongoing monitoring to ensure that AI tools meet standards for privacy, accessibility, transparency, and instructional value.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Districts", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
